events.title: Kaironia 0.2.1: Combat, Recall, and Multiplayer Fixes
events.summary: Kaironia 0.2.1 is now live.COMBAT- Reduced low-level monster damage, with maximum hits increasing more gradually through the early levels.- Auto-Eat uses the higher of your chosen threshold and 10 HP, capped at 80% of maximum health.- Automatic retaliation no longer closes the Codex or interrupts keyboard focus.MAGIC- Low and High Transmutation, Chronostatic Enchantment, Alchemical Smelt, and Chronobake now have casting animations and sound.- Fixed casting inventory utility spells in multiplayer

events.title: Kaironia Demo 0.1.3: Maps, Controls & Multiplayer Fixes
events.summary: Kaironia Demo 0.1.3 is now live. This update focuses on maps, loading, controls, dedicated servers, and multiplayer reliability.This update includes the following changes:ADDED- Codex: Codex bookmarks for recipes, skill guides, locations, pets, and challenges.- Teleportation: A loading animation for teleporting, with a still version when Reduced Motion is enabled.- World: Occasional creature chatter, controlled by the Creature Chatter filter.- World Map: Combinable World Map layers, clearer play

events.title: Kaironia Demo 0.1.2: Dedicated Server Fixes
events.summary: Kaironia Demo 0.1.2 is now live, with a focus on dedicated-server and multiplayer reliability.This update includes the following fixes:FIXED- Multiplayer: Dedicated servers can now host public demo or full-game sessions through Steam Relay without port forwarding. events.title: The Kaironia Demo Is Live! 🎉
events.summary: Explore the Drifted Lands, train your skills to level 20, gather and process resources, craft equipment, complete quests, fight monsters, fill your Codex, and put your offline Time Bank to work. You can play at your own pace in single-player or bring your traveler into optional multiplayer. This is an early look at Kaironia, and your experience with it genuinely matters.
